# 2) Loading input files

## - Loading gene annotation files

We use the following code to download a gene annotation file, convert it into a SQLite database for genomic analysis, or load the existing database if it's already present.

### - Load check or creation of sqlite file

```{r}
# Define the path to the SQLite database
txdb.filename <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.annotation.sqlite", sep = '')

# Check if the SQLite database already exists
if (file.exists(txdb.filename)) {
  
  # Print a message indicating that the database already exists and is being loaded
  print(sprintf('File %s already exist! Now Loading...',txdb.filename))
  
  # Load the SQLite database
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)
  
} else {

  # Define the URL of the GTF file to download
  url <- "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_42/gencode.v42.annotation.gtf.gz"
  
  dir.create(paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files", sep = ''), 
             showWarnings = F)
  
  # Define the local path where the GTF file will be saved
  destfile <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.annotation.gtf.gz", sep = '')
  
  # Download the GTF file
  download.file(url, destfile)
  
  # Define the path of the decompressed GTF file
  gtf <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.annotation.gtf", sep = '')
  
  # If the decompressed GTF file already exists, remove it
  if (file.exists(gtf)) {
    file.remove(gtf)
  }
  
  # Decompress the GTF file
  gunzip(destfile)

  # Create a TxDb object from the GTF file
  txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf)
  
  # Save the TxDb object as a SQLite database for later use
  saveDb(txdb, txdb.filename)
  
  # Load the SQLite database
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)

  # Print a message indicating that the SQLite database has been generated
  print(sprintf('File %s has been generated!',txdb.filename))

}
```

### - Load check or creation of csv file

We use the following code to load gene metadata from a CSV file, or if it's not present, to extract it from a GTF file and create the CSV.

```{r}
# Define the path to the gene metadata CSV file
gencode_gene_info_df.filename <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv", sep = '')

# Check if the CSV file already exists
if (file.exists(gencode_gene_info_df.filename)) {
  
  # Print a message indicating that the CSV file already exists
  print(sprintf('File %s already exist! Now Loading...',gencode_gene_info_df.filename))
  
  # Load the CSV file into a dataframe
  Genes_annotation_metadata <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv', sep = ''), header = TRUE)
  
  # Set the row names of the dataframe to the gene IDs
  rownames(Genes_annotation_metadata) <- Genes_annotation_metadata$gene_id
  
} else {
  
  # Define the path to the GTF file and the SQLite database
  gtf <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.annotation.gtf", sep = '')
  txdb.filename <- paste(data_folder, "/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.annotation.sqlite", sep = '')
  
  # Load the SQLite database
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)
  
  # Load the GTF file into a dataframe
  gtf_df <- read.table(file = gtf, sep="\t", header=FALSE)
  
  # Filter the dataframe to include only rows where the third column is 'gene'
  gtf_df_genes <- gtf_df %>% dplyr::filter(V3 == 'gene')
  
  # Create an empty dataframe to store the gene metadata
  gencode_gene_info_df <- data.frame()
  
  # Create a progress bar
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(gtf_df_genes), style = 3)
  
  # Iterate over the rows of the filtered dataframe
  for (gene_index in 1:nrow(gtf_df_genes)) {
    
    # Update the progress bar
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, gene_index)
    
    # Extract the gene information from the ninth column of the current row
    gene_info <- gsub(";\\s+", ";", gtf_df_genes[gene_index,'V9'])
    
    # Split the gene information into items
    items <- strsplit(gene_info, ";")[[1]]
    
    # Iterate over the items and split each one on the space
    for (item in items) {
      parts <- unlist(strsplit(item, " "))
      
      # If there are exactly two parts, add them to the dataframe as a new column
      if (length(parts) == 2) {
        gencode_gene_info_df[unlist(strsplit(items[[1]], " "))[[2]],sprintf('%s',parts[1])] <- parts[2]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Close the progress bar
  close(pb)
  
  # Write the dataframe to a CSV file
  write.csv(x = gencode_gene_info_df, file = gencode_gene_info_df.filename, row.names = F)
  
  # Print a message indicating that the CSV file has been generated
  print(sprintf('File %s has been generated! Now loading...',gencode_gene_info_df.filename))
  
  # Load the CSV file into a dataframe
  Genes_annotation_metadata <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Annotation_files/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv', sep = ''), header = TRUE)
  
  # Set the row names of the dataframe to the gene IDs
  rownames(Genes_annotation_metadata) <- Genes_annotation_metadata$gene_id
}
```

# 3) Importing and grouping raw counts

Here we check for the existence of a specific RDS file. If it doesn't exist, we perform gene-level summarization and save the results as CSV files.

```{r}
# Define the path to the RDS file
rds_file <- paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Tximport_object.rds', sep = '')

# Check if the RDS file exists
if (!file.exists(rds_file)) {

  ## - Loading counts path
  
  STAR_Salmon_output_path <- paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Raw_counts/Individual', sep = '')
  
  files <- file.path(STAR_Salmon_output_path, list.files(STAR_Salmon_output_path), "quant.sf")
  names(files) <- list.files(STAR_Salmon_output_path)
  
  ## - Gene-level summarization via tximport
  
  k <- keys(txdb, keytype = "TXNAME")
  tx2gene <- AnnotationDbi::select(txdb, k, "GENEID", "TXNAME")
  
  TXI.Genes <- tximport(files, type="salmon", tx2gene=tx2gene, 
                    txIn = TRUE, txOut = FALSE, countsFromAbundance = 'no')
  
  TXI.Genes$abundance <- TXI.Genes$abundance[,rownames(Samples_metadata)]
  TXI.Genes$counts <- TXI.Genes$counts[,rownames(Samples_metadata)]
  TXI.Genes$length <- TXI.Genes$length[,rownames(Samples_metadata)]
  
  saveRDS(TXI.Genes, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Tximport_object.rds', sep = ''))
  
  ## - Exporting gene-level counts and TPMs
  
  dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Raw_counts/Grouped', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
  
  dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
  dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
  dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
  
  write.csv(x = TXI.Genes$counts, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Raw_counts/Grouped/Tximport_raw_countmat.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
  
  write.csv(x = TXI.Genes$abundance, file =  paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped/Tximport_TPM_mat.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)

}
```

# 4) DESeq2 Analysis

## - Loading read and TPM matrices

This script creates a new directory named 'DESeq2' under the 'RNASeq/InHouse' directory. If the directory already exists, it doesn't show any warnings. After that, it reads an RDS file named 'Tximport_object.rds' from the 'Counts' directory under 'RNASeq/InHouse'. The data from the RDS file is stored in the TXI.Genes variable.

```{r}
# Create directory and read RDS file
dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
TXI.Genes <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Tximport_object.rds', sep = ''))
```

## - Create a DESeqDataSet from the Tximport object

Here we create a DESeqDataSet object from the gene-level summarization data. This object is used for differential expression analysis, with the Comparison (e.g., Resistin treated vs. control) as the variable of interest.

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = TXI.Genes, 
  colData = Samples_metadata,
  rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
  design = ~ Comparison
)
```

## - Filtering non-unique uninformative Ensembl.id

Here we normalize the count data, filter out rows based on the normalized counts, and then perform differential expression analysis using the DESeq2 package.

```{r}
# Estimate size factors
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)

# Filter rows based on normalized counts
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE) >= 5 ) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep,]

# Run DESeq
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

Here we check the uniqueness of gene names in our dataset. For non-unique gene names, we keep only the row with the maximum absolute expression and remove the rest to ensure uniqueness.

```{r}
# Check uniqueness of gene names
unique_gene_names <- isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name)
print(table(unique_gene_names))

# Get rows with non-unique gene names
non_unique_rows <- rowData(dds)[grep(FALSE, unique_gene_names),]
df <- as.data.frame(non_unique_rows)

# Get maximum absolute value of Expression by Gene
maxabs <- with(df, aggregate(baseMean, list(gene_name=gene_name), FUN=function(x) max(abs(x))))

# Merge with original data frame
df <- merge(df, maxabs, by="gene_name")

# Get rows with maximum absolute expression
df_unique <- subset(df, abs(baseMean) == x)

# Remove duplicate genes
df_unique <- df_unique[!duplicated(df_unique$gene_name), ]
```

Here we extract unique gene IDs from our dataset and write them to a CSV file. We then verify the uniqueness of these gene IDs.

```{r}
# Get unique gene IDs
unique_genes <- c(rowData(dds)[grep(TRUE,isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name)),]$gene_id, df_unique$gene_id)

# Write unique genes to CSV
write.csv(x = data.frame(unique_genes), 
          file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/List_unique_genes.csv', sep = ''), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# Check uniqueness of unique genes
print(table(isUnique(unique_genes)))
```

Here we calculate the difference in the count of unique gene IDs before and after removing duplicates. We then compute the proportion of this difference relative to the total count of unique gene IDs after duplicate removal.

```{r}
# Calculate difference in uniqueness counts
diff_uniqueness <- table(isUnique(unique_genes)) - table(isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name))[[2]]
print(diff_uniqueness)

# Calculate proportion of difference
proportion_diff <- diff_uniqueness / table(isUnique(unique_genes))
print(proportion_diff)
```

## - Running DESeq2 with unique genes

## - Testing parametric dispersion vs local

This script performs differential expression analysis using both parametric and local fit types, and then determines the best scoring fit type based on the median absolute residuals.

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.pos='H', fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
# Create DESeqDataSet and perform DESeq analysis with parametric fit
dds_parametric <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, colData = Samples_metadata, rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], design = ~ Comparison)
dds_parametric <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_parametric)
dds_parametric <- dds_parametric[unique_genes,]
dds_parametric <- DESeq(dds_parametric, fitType = "parametric")

# Calculate and plot residuals for parametric fit
Residuals_parametric <- log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispGeneEst) - log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispFit)
plotDispEsts(dds_parametric, main= "dispEst: Parametric")
hist(x = Residuals_parametric, xlim = c(-20,10))
Median_Absolute_Residual_parametric <- median(abs(Residuals_parametric))

# Create DESeqDataSet and perform DESeq analysis with local fit
dds_local <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, colData = Samples_metadata, rowData= Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], design = ~ Comparison)
dds_local <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_local)
dds_local <- dds_local[unique_genes,]
dds_local <- DESeq(dds_local, fitType = "local")

# Calculate and plot residuals for local fit
Residuals_local <- log(mcols(dds_local)$dispGeneEst) - log(mcols(dds_local)$dispFit)
plotDispEsts(dds_local, main= "dispEst: Local")
hist(x = Residuals_local, xlim = c(-20,10))
Median_Absolute_Residual_local <- median(abs(Residuals_local))

# Determine best scoring fit type
Best_scoring_fitType <- ifelse(Median_Absolute_Residual_parametric < Median_Absolute_Residual_local, 'parametric', 'local')
```

Here we create a DESeqDataSet object from the gene-level summarization data, normalize the count data, filter out rows based on unique genes, and then perform differential expression analysis using the best scoring fit type.

```{r}
# Create a DESeqDataSet from the Tximport object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = TXI.Genes, 
  colData = Samples_metadata,
  rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
  design = ~ Comparison
)

# Estimate size factors
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)

# Filter rows based on unique genes
dds <- dds[unique_genes,]

# Run DESeq with the best scoring fit type
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = Best_scoring_fitType)
```

## - Generating VST and RLOG normalised counts

Here we generate variance stabilizing transformation (vst) and rlog normalized counts from our dataset. These normalized counts are then written to CSV files for further analysis.

```{r}
# Generate vst normalised counts
vst <- vst(dds, blind=FALSE)
vst_mat <- as.data.frame(assay(vst)) %>% 
  add_column(GeneSymbol = rowData(vst)$gene_name, .before = colnames(dds)[1]) %>% 
  add_column(GeneBiotype = rowData(vst)$gene_type, .before = colnames(dds)[1]) 

# Write vst normalised counts to CSV
write.csv(vst_mat, 
          file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped/DESeq2_vst_normalised_countmat.csv', sep = ''), quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE)

# Generate rlog normalised counts
rlog <- rlogTransformation(dds, blind=FALSE)
rlog_mat <- as.data.frame(assay(rlog)) %>% 
  add_column(GeneSymbol = rowData(rlog)$gene_name, .before = colnames(dds)[1]) %>% 
  add_column(GeneBiotype = rowData(rlog)$gene_type, .before = colnames(dds)[1]) 

# Write rlog normalised counts to CSV
write.csv(rlog_mat, 
          file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped/DESeq2_rlog_normalised_countmat.csv', sep = ''), quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE)
```

## - Exporting filtered fpkm matrix

```{r}
write.csv(x = fpkm(dds), file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped/DESeq2_FPKM_normalized_countmat.csv', sep = ''), quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE)
```

## - Performing PCA analysis

Here we perform Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the top 500 genes with the highest variance. We then calculate the variance explained by each principal component and the total variance explained by the first three principal components.

```{r}
rv <- rowVars(assay(rlog))
# select the ntop genes by variance
select <- order(rv, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(rv)))]
# perform a PCA on the data in assay(x) for the selected genes
pca <- prcomp(t(assay(rlog)[select,]))

pca_samples <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
pca_samples$Comparison <- colData(dds)[rownames(pca_samples),'Comparison']
pca_samples$Donor <- colData(dds)[rownames(pca_samples),'Donor']
pca_samples$Hours <- colData(dds)[rownames(pca_samples),'Hours']

pca_genes <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation)
pca_genes <- add_column(pca_genes, .before = 'PC1', GeneSymbol = rowData(dds)[rownames(pca_genes),'gene_name'])

dir.create(path = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/PCs', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)

write.csv(pca_samples, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/PCs/DGE_Samples_PCs_from_rlog_normalised_count_mat.csv', sep = ''), quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

write.csv(pca_genes, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/PCs/DGE_Genes_PCs_from_rlog_normalised_count_mat.csv', sep = ''), quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)


var_explained_df <- data.frame(PC= paste0("PC",1:28),
                               var_explained=(pca$sdev)^2/sum((pca$sdev)^2))

write.csv(var_explained_df, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/PCs/DGE_PC_variance_explained.csv', sep = ''), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

tot_var_explained <- (var_explained_df$var_explained[1] + 
  var_explained_df$var_explained[2] +
  var_explained_df$var_explained[3]) * 100

dir.create(path = './Results/Figures', showWarnings = F)

pca_samples$Comparison <- factor(pca_samples$Comparison, levels = c('0hrs_initial', '6hrs_control', '24hrs_control', '6hrs_LPS', '24hrs_LPS', '6hrs_resistin', '24hrs_resistin'))
pca_samples$Hours <- factor(pca_samples$Hours, levels = c('0hrs', '6hrs', '24hrs'))

png(filename = './Figures/Monocytes/PCA_from_rlog_mat.png', width = 1024*1.6, height = 1024*1.6*0.66, units = 'px', res = 300)

plot <- ggplot(pca_samples, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour=Comparison, shape=Hours)) + geom_point(size=2) + scale_colour_manual(values = c('0hrs_initial' = '#A4BECE',
                                          '6hrs_control' = '#669bbc',
                                          '24hrs_control' = '#003049',
                                          '6hrs_LPS' = '#87c38f',
                                          '24hrs_LPS' = '#226f54',
                                          '6hrs_resistin' = '#c1121f',
                                          '24hrs_resistin' = '#780000')) + theme_bw()
print(plot)

dev.off()


pdf(file = './Figures/Monocytes/PCA_from_rlog_mat.pdf', width = 7, height = 5)

plot <- ggplot(pca_samples, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, colour=Comparison, shape=Hours)) + geom_point(size = 3) + scale_colour_manual(values = c('0hrs_initial' = '#A4BECE',
                                          '6hrs_control' = '#669bbc',
                                          '24hrs_control' = '#003049',
                                          '6hrs_LPS' = '#87c38f',
                                          '24hrs_LPS' = '#226f54',
                                          '6hrs_resistin' = '#c1121f',
                                          '24hrs_resistin' = '#780000')) + theme_bw()

```

## - Plotting 3d PCs via plotly

This script defines a list of font characteristics to be used in Plotly plots.

```{r}
# Define font characteristics to use on plotly plots
Font_characteristics <- list(
  family = "Helvetica",
  size = 14,
  color = "black"
)
```

This script creates a 3D scatter plot of the first three principal components from the PCA analysis, with points colored by Comparison. The plot is then customized with a specific layout and saved as a PNG file.

With legend

```{r}
fig <- plot_ly(pca_samples, 
               x = ~PC2, y = ~PC1, z = ~PC3, color = ~Comparison, 
               colors = c('0hrs_initial' = '#A4BECE',
                                          '6hrs_control' = '#669bbc',
                                          '24hrs_control' = '#003049',
                                          '6hrs_LPS' = '#226f54',
                                          '24hrs_LPS' = '#DD3429',
                                          '6hrs_resistin' = '#c1121f',
                                          '24hrs_resistin' = '#780000')) %>% add_markers(size = 12, marker = list (size = 12))

fig <- fig %>% layout(
    title = '',
    showlegend = FALSE,
    legend=list(title='', font = Font_characteristics),
    scene = list(bgcolor = "#ffffff",
                 camera = list(
                     eye = list(
                         x = -1.75,
                         y = 1.85,
                         z = 1.04
                     ),
                     center = list(x = 0,
                                   y = 0,
                                   z = 0)
                 )))

fig


# Save the figure as a PNG file

```

## - DEGs

Here we load useful gene metadata

```{r}
# Read the transcription factors list
TF_list <- read.csv(
  file = paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Gene_Metadata/Lambert2018_TFs.txt', sep = ''), 
  sep = '\t', 
  header = FALSE
)

# Read the HGNC CD markers list
HGNC_CD_markers_list <- read.csv(
  file = paste(data_folder, '/Resources/RNASeq/Gene_Metadata/HGNC_CD_Markers.csv', sep = '')
)
```

### - Pairwise comparisons

#### - Test vs 0hrs initial

```{r}
control <- '0hrs_initial'
test_groups <- c('6hrs_control', '24hrs_control', '6hrs_LPS', '24hrs_LPS', '6hrs_resistin', '24hrs_resistin')

dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial', sep = ''), showWarnings = FALSE)
  
results <- list()
# Relevel the Comparison factor to set control as the reference level
dds$Comparison <- relevel(dds$Comparison, control)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
  
# Loop through each comparison in the Comparison factor except control
for (test in setdiff(test_groups, control)) {
    
    name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", test, "_vs_", control, sep = '')
    dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', name_comparison, sep = ''), showWarnings = FALSE)
    
    set.seed(123)
    
    # Explicitly set the contrast
    res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Comparison", test, control), filterFun = ihw)
    res <- as.data.frame(res)
    res <- add_column(.data = res, .before = 'baseMean', Gene = rowData(dds)[which(rowData(dds)$gene_id == rownames(res)), 'gene_name'])
    
    res_significant <- res %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.5)
    res_significant$Rank <- -log10(res_significant$padj) * res_significant$log2FoldChange
    res_significant$Rank <- abs(res_significant$Rank)
    res_significant$Is_TF <- 'No'
    res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% TF_list$V1), 'Is_TF'] <- 'Yes'
    res_significant$Is_CD_marker <- 'No'
    res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% HGNC_CD_markers_list$Approved.symbol), 'Is_CD_marker'] <- 'Yes'
    
    results[[name_comparison]] <- res_significant %>% arrange(-Rank)
    
    write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', name_comparison, '/UP_in_', test, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE)
    write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', name_comparison, '/UP_in_', control, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE)
    write.csv(x = res, file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', name_comparison, '/ALL_DEGs.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE)

}
```

# 5) Vulcano Plots

## - Test vs 0hrs initial

This script creates a volcano plot of differential expression results, adding log10 transformed p-value and fold change, defining a color scheme, and identifying genes of interest. The plot is then displayed and saved as a PNG file.

```{r}
dirs <- list.files(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial', sep = ''))

test_groups <- sub("Comparison_(.*?)_vs_.*", "\\1", dirs)

DEGs_ALL <- list()
DEGs_UP <- list()
DEGs_DN <- list()

for (test in test_groups) {
  
  subdir <- dirs[str_detect(dirs, test)]
  DEGs_ALL[[test]] <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', subdir, '/ALL_DEGs.csv', sep = ''))
  DEGs_UP[[test]] <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', subdir, '/UP_in_', test, '.csv', sep = ''))
  DEGs_DN[[test]] <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_0hrs_initial/', subdir, '/UP_in_0hrs_initial.csv', sep = ''))
  
}
```

```{r echo=TRUE, fig.align='center', fig.cap='Figure 2D', fig.pos='H', fig.height=5.5, fig.width=4.3}
for (test in test_groups) {
  
    # Filter directories
  subdir <- dirs[str_detect(dirs, test)]
  
  # Rename the results df into another object
  genemat_ord <- DEGs_ALL[[test]]
  genemat_ord$log10p <- -log10(genemat_ord$pvalue)
  genemat_ord <- na.omit(genemat_ord)
  
  # Assign colors based on log2FoldChange and pvalue
  genemat_ord$color <- ifelse(
    genemat_ord$log2FoldChange <= -1 & genemat_ord$pvalue < 50e-3, 
    'Downregulated',
    ifelse(genemat_ord$log2FoldChange >= 1 & genemat_ord$pvalue < 50e-3, 
           'Upregulated',
      ifelse(genemat_ord$pvalue < 50e-3, 
             'Significant with no LFC', 'NS')
    )
  )
  
  # Assign sizes based on specific genes
  genemat_ord$size <- ifelse(
    genemat_ord$Gene %in% c(''), 3, 1.4
  )
  
  # Assign text colors based on specific genes
  genemat_ord$text_color <- ifelse(
    genemat_ord$Gene %in% c(''), '#c1121f', 'grey28'
  )
  genemat_ord$text_color <- setNames(genemat_ord$text_color, genemat_ord$Gene)
  
  # Define limits for LFC and p-value
  LFC_lim <- max(abs(genemat_ord$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) + 1
  Pval_lim <- max(genemat_ord$log10p) + 0.1
  
  # Define genes of interest
  UP_Genes <- (DEGs_UP[[test]] %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']
  DN_Genes <- (DEGs_DN[[test]] %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']
  
  # Create the plot
  plot <- ggplot(data = genemat_ord, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log10p)) + 
    geom_point(aes(colour = color), size = genemat_ord$size, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c('NS' = '#727272', 'Upregulated' = '#C92A1D', 
                                  'Downregulated' = '#415384', 
                                  'Significant with no LFC' = '#F7E4D7')) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey10", 
               size = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey10", 
               size = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0),
                    aes(label = Gene), 
                    col = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
                      pull(text_color),
                    nudge_x = LFC_lim - 1 - genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
                      pull(log2FoldChange),
                    alpha = 0.8, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey50", 
                    direction = "y", hjust = 0, force = 3, fontface = 'bold', 
                    size = 3, segment.curvature = -0.01, segment.ncp = 5, 
                    segment.angle = 20, segment.square = TRUE, 
                    segment.inflect = FALSE, 
                    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.006, "npc"), type = "closed", 
                                  ends = "last")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0),
                    aes(label = Gene),
                    col = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
                      pull(text_color),
                    nudge_x = -LFC_lim + 1 - genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
                      pull(log2FoldChange),
                    alpha = 0.8, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey50", 
                    direction = "y", hjust = 1, force = 3, fontface = 'bold', 
                    size = 3, segment.curvature = -0.01, segment.ncp = 5, 
                    segment.angle = 20, segment.square = TRUE, 
                    segment.inflect = FALSE, 
                    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.006, "npc"), type = "closed", 
                                  ends = "last")) +
    xlim(c(-LFC_lim - 2, LFC_lim + 2)) +
    ylim(c(-0.05, Pval_lim)) +
    theme_bw(base_line_size = 0.2) + 
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(family = 'Helvetica', size = 12, 
                                      face = 'bold'),
          axis.title.x = element_text(family = 'Helvetica', size = 12, 
                                      face = 'bold'),
          legend.position = 'bottom') + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = ''), size = 'none')
  
    
  print(plot)
  
  # Save the plot to a PNG file
  png(filename = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', subdir, '_vulcanoplot.png', sep = ''), units = 'in', width = 6, height = 7, res = 300)
  print(plot)
  invisible(dev.off())
  
  # We also save a PDF copy to be used to assemble a high resolution composite figure for the manuscript (render not included in GitHub repo due to size restriction)
  pdf(file = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', subdir, '_vulcanoplot.pdf', sep = ''), width = 6, height = 7)
  print(plot)
  invisible(dev.off())

}
```

  LFC_lim <- max(abs(genemat_ord$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE) + 1
  Pval_lim <- max(genemat_ord$log10p) + 0.1
  
  # Define genes of interest
  UP_Genes <- (DEGs_UP[[test]] %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']
  DN_Genes <- (DEGs_DN[[test]] %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']
  
  # Create the plot
  plot <- ggplot(data = genemat_ord, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = log10p)) + 
    geom_point(aes(colour = color), size = genemat_ord$size, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c('NS' = '#727272', 'Upregulated' = '#C92A1D', 
                                  'Downregulated' = '#415384', 
                                  'Significant with no LFC' = '#F7E4D7')) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey10", 
               size = 0.35) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey10", 
               size = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0),
                    aes(label = Gene), 
                    col = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
                      pull(text_color),
                    nudge_x = LFC_lim - 1 - genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange > 0) %>% 
                      pull(log2FoldChange),
                    alpha = 0.8, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey50", 
                    direction = "y", hjust = 0, force = 3, fontface = 'bold', 
                    size = 3, segment.curvature = -0.01, segment.ncp = 5, 
                    segment.angle = 20, segment.square = TRUE, 
                    segment.inflect = FALSE, 
                    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.006, "npc"), type = "closed", 
                                  ends = "last")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0),
                    aes(label = Gene),
                    col = genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
                      pull(text_color),
                    nudge_x = -LFC_lim + 1 - genemat_ord %>% 
                      filter(Gene %in% c(UP_Genes, DN_Genes) & log2FoldChange < 0) %>% 
                      pull(log2FoldChange),
                    alpha = 0.8, segment.size = 0.2, segment.color = "grey50", 
                    direction = "y", hjust = 1, force = 3, fontface = 'bold', 
                    size = 3, segment.curvature = -0.01, segment.ncp = 5, 
                    segment.angle = 20, segment.square = TRUE, 
                    segment.inflect = FALSE, 
                    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.006, "npc"), type = "closed", 
                                  ends = "last")) +
    xlim(c(-LFC_lim - 2, LFC_lim + 2)) +
    ylim(c(-0.05, Pval_lim)) +
    theme_bw(base_line_size = 0.2) + 
    theme(axis.title.y = element_text(family = 'Helvetica', size = 12, 
                                      face = 'bold'),
          axis.title.x = element_text(family = 'Helvetica', size = 12, 
                                      face = 'bold'),
          legend.position = 'bottom') + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = ''), size = 'none')
  
    
  print(plot)
  
  # Save the plot to a PNG file
  png(filename = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', subdir, '_vulcanoplot.png', sep = ''), units = 'in', width = 6, height = 7, res = 300)
  print(plot)
  invisible(dev.off())
  
  # We also save a PDF copy to be used to assemble a high resolution composite figure for the manuscript (render not included in GitHub repo due to size restriction)
  pdf(file = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', subdir, '_vulcanoplot.pdf', sep = ''), width = 6, height = 7)
  print(plot)
  invisible(dev.off())

}

# 6) Heatmap

## - Identifying marker genes for each condition

### - Creating dds object without intercept

```{r}
dds = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~0 + Comparison)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds <- dds[unique_genes,]
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = Best_scoring_fitType)
```
### - Performing comparison to rest

```{r}
results <- list()

dir.create(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_rest', sep = ''), showWarnings = FALSE)

for (comparison in resultsNames(dds)) {
  
  name_condition <- gsub("Comparison", "", comparison)
  name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", name_condition, "_vs_ALL", sep = '')
  
  res <- results(dds, contrast = list(c(comparison),setdiff(resultsNames(dds), comparison)), listValues=c(1, -1/7), filterFun = ihw)
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
  res <- add_column(.data = res, .before= 'baseMean', Gene= rowData(dds)[which(rowData(dds)$gene_id == rownames(res)),'gene_name'])
    
  res_significant <- res %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.5)
  res_significant$Rank <- -log10(res_significant$padj) * res_significant$log2FoldChange
  res_significant$Rank <- Mod(res_significant$Rank)
  res_significant$Is_TF <- 'No'
  res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% TF_list$V1),'Is_TF'] <- 'Yes'
  res_significant$Is_CD_marker <- 'No'
  res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% HGNC_CD_markers_list$Approved.symbol),'Is_CD_marker'] <- 'Yes'
    
  results[[name_comparison]] <- res_significant %>% arrange(-Rank)
    
    write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/DESeq2/Monocytes/DEGs_Comparisons/Comparisons_to_rest/UP_in_', name_condition, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = TRUE)
    
}
```

### - Plotting heatmap

```{r}
# Read and process the data
RLog_results_mat <- read.csv(paste(data_folder, '/RNASeq/InHouse/Counts/Monocytes/Processed_counts/Grouped/DESeq2_rlog_normalised_countmat.csv', sep = ''), row.names = 'X')
colnames(RLog_results_mat) <- str_replace_all(colnames(RLog_results_mat), pattern = 'X', replacement = '')

# Subset the data
RLog_results_mat__subset <- RLog_results_mat[grep(TRUE, RLog_results_mat$GeneSymbol %in% unique(unlist(DEGs_UP))),]
rownames(RLog_results_mat__subset) <- RLog_results_mat__subset$GeneSymbol
RLog_results_mat__subset$GeneSymbol <- NULL
RLog_results_mat__subset$GeneBiotype <- NULL
RLog_results_mat__subset <- as.matrix(RLog_results_mat__subset)

# Scale the data
Scaled_RLog_results_mat__subset <- t(scale(t(RLog_results_mat__subset)))[,]
Scaled_RLog_results_mat__subset <- t(Scaled_RLog_results_mat__subset)

# Prepare phenotype data
Phenotype_identity <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(dds))
Phenotype_identity$Comparison <- dds$Comparison
Phenotype_identity$Comparison <- factor(Phenotype_identity$Comparison, levels = c('0hrs_initial', '6hrs_control', '24hrs_control', '6hrs_LPS', '24hrs_LPS', '6hrs_resistin', '24hrs_resistin'))

# Define colors for annotations
colors_annotation <- list(Comparison = c('0hrs_initial' = '#A4BECE',
                                         '6hrs_control' = '#669bbc',
                                         '24hrs_control' = '#003049',
                                         '6hrs_LPS' = '#87c38f',
                                         '24hrs_LPS' = '#226f54',
                                         '6hrs_resistin' = '#c1121f',
                                         '24hrs_resistin' = '#780000'))

# Create row annotation
ha <- rowAnnotation(df = Phenotype_identity, col = colors_annotation, 
                    gp = gpar(lwd = 0.5, col = 'white'),
                    simple_anno_size = unit(0.25, 'cm'),
                    show_annotation_name = FALSE, show_legend = FALSE,
                    annotation_legend_param = list(Comparison = list(direction = "horizontal")))

# Define heatmap colors and breaks
breaks_val <- seq(from = -1.5, to = 2, length.out = 13)
col_heatmap_guide <- colorRamp2(breaks = breaks_val, colors = rev(brew_mix))

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Create heatmap
Heatmap_genes <- Heatmap(Scaled_RLog_results_mat__subset, name = 'Scaled\nExpression',
                            col = col_heatmap_guide,
                            show_row_names = FALSE, 
                            show_column_names = F,
                            cluster_columns = TRUE,
                            cluster_rows = FALSE,
                            row_split = Phenotype_identity$Comparison,
                            border = TRUE,
                            cluster_row_slices = TRUE,
                            row_gap = unit(0.05, 'cm'),
                            column_gap = unit(0.05, 'cm'),
                            show_column_dend = F, 
                            row_dend_side = 'right',
                            column_names_side = 'bottom',
                            use_raster = FALSE, 
                            rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.05),
                            raster_by_magick = TRUE, 
                            left_annotation = ha,
                            row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, angle=45),
                            row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, hjust=0),
                            column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
                            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, hjust=0),
                            show_heatmap_legend = F,
                            heatmap_legend_param = list(
                                      legend_direction = "horizontal", 
                                      legend_width = unit(5, "cm")))

#

png(filename = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', 'DGE_Top_30_UP_DEGs_per_condition.png', sep = ''), width = 13, height = 7, units = 'in', res = 300)
  
# Draw heatmap
ComplexHeatmap::draw(Heatmap_genes, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", 
                     annotation_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()

#

pdf(file = paste(figures_folder, '/Monocytes/', 'DGE_Top_30_UP_DEGs_per_condition.pdf', sep = ''), width = 13, height = 7)

# Draw heatmap
ComplexHeatmap::draw(Heatmap_genes, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", 
                     annotation_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```
